assertion_analysis.fails_if: The selected iterator is not forwarded or filtering returns all rows; the fixture has multiple independent rows and the negative-control log records all four cases failing.
A selected read changes the aggregate version instead of preserving the unselected version.
Selection changes members, holds or auxiliary version relative to the independently read full projection.
An empty selection is interpreted as all records or ignored.
The interleaved write or successful retry fails to advance the store to version 2.
The writer is bypassed, a stale write succeeds without retry or more than one retry occurs.
The retry omits backoff or repeats it at the wrong attempt.
The real stale-version guard does not refuse expected 0 against stored 1, or the refusal is not propagated.
The independently reloaded store does not persist the successful returned hold.
A hold mutation creates the aggregate file.

assertion_independence: The selected identity also appears as input, but the expected population comes from a multi-row fixture and missing forwarding demonstrably reddens the assertion; this is not an assertion whose sides remain equal under the guarded regression. The hold persistence assertion compares an independent read with the return, not a value supplied as both expected and actual.
